comparison.objective: Seat a keyed jig plate on round and diamond locating pins versus commission a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Multi-pin pose alignment and insertion of a plate versus hex-key alignment, collar adjustment, force-limited locking, and response-based iteration.
comparison.success_condition: Plate must seat in its sole fitting orientation; candidate must retain a tuned setting and pass two constrained physical cycles.
comparison.reason: Fixture seating and locating-pin alignment are different tested abilities from damping calibration. Full seating tolerances and damage rules are unavailable.
